sources.title: Realistic Vision V6.0 B1 - V5.1 Hyper (VAE) | Stable ... - Civitai
sources.snippet: Recommendations for using the Hyper model: Sampler = DPM SDE++ Karras or another / 4-6+ steps CFG Scale = 1.5-2.0 (the lower the value, the more mutations, but the less contrast) I also recommend using ADetailer for generation (some examples were generated with ADetailer, this will be noted in the image comments).

sources.title: AI Resource Hub — Free AI Model Downloads & Resources
sources.snippet: Realistic Vision V2.0 is purpose-built for photorealistic human portraits. It excels at skin texture, eye detail, hair strands, and natural lighting that closely resembles actual photography. The model has been fine-tuned specifically to reduce the 'AI look' that many general models produce.

sources.title: Realistic Vision V20 2047 - Stable Diffusion API
sources.snippet: What parameters does Realistic Vision V20 2047 support? Realistic Vision V20 2047 accepts standard Stable Diffusion parameters: prompt, negative_prompt, width, height, samples, num_inference_steps (default 30), guidance_scale (default 7.5), seed, and safety_checker.
